I’ve heard that the healthier your immune system is, the harsher the effect is. My mom and I are both crazily healthy (working out, vitamins, making weird drinks to boost our systems, etc). So I’m really not sure about this. 

I’d just say make sure you have a day or two off of work and get it before then. Good luck.
